answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving nutrients through soil, consensus blossoms via mutual endorsement graphs where trust crystallizes locally. When an entity seeks entry, incumbent nodes cast cryptographic stalks like yarrow sticks for divination, verifying organic work before letting any peer harbor authority. Sybil fabrication collapses because validating cloned identities imposes superlinear attacker cost: multiplying nodes without genuine cross-stake demands polynomial collateral, leaving a fraudulent swarm as empty as an artificial sparrow unable to sing.
